title: Services are not automatically started upon package installation
description: Unlike Debian/Ubuntu, installing a package on RHEL does not start or enable the systemd service.
do_not_do: Do not assume the service is running after dnf install.

title: SELinux context preservation on mv vs cp
description: Moving files preserves the original context, while copying inherits the destination context.
recommendation: Always run sudo restorecon -Rv <path> when moving config or web root files.
do_not_do: Do not disable SELinux permanently when a context mismatch occurs.

title: Firewalld rules require --permanent and --reload
description: firewall-cmd rules without --permanent are volatile and lost upon service restart or reboot.
do_not_do: Do not omit --permanent unless testing temporary rules intentionally.
